strategyReview: Portfolio realized PnL is positive on a 446-trade basis with a 62.6% win rate, but the current open GOLD long is flat and recent ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadows have turned into a losing cluster across BTC, GOLD, and OIL as spot trends upward. FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG and FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT remain marginal losers overall; however, asset-level breakdowns reveal that FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG works well on GOLD (69% win) while FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT works on AMZN (79% win) but both bleed in other assets, making pure asset selection critical. PC_RATIO_EXTREME_HIGH and PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW are mild net positives and continue to operate within expectations. Several eligible shadow-only setups (WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG, USER_PM_IV_TOUCH_RICH_NO, MONOTONIC_ARB) are strong but remain blocked, representing the largest untapped edge.

failureClusters.theme: ONE_TOUCH_NO edge selling failures in uptrends
failureClusters.evidence: Of 8 recently resolved trades, 6 were ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadows that ended in thesis_compressed_loss across BTC, GOLD, and OIL, while spot price likely moved against the shorts. The overall shadow win rate is 37% and the open ONE_TOUCH warnings show wide bid/ask spreads, indicating the pure edge signal is overwhelmed when spot sustains an uptrend.
failureClusters.recommendation: Add a trend/momentum guard: only trigger sell-YES when spot is below its 24h SMA and 24h price change is less than +1.5%. Consider blocking signals entirely if the asset is above its 7d high in a strong uptrend, and test this as a new hypothesis under the ONE_TOUCH family.

failureClusters.evidence: Live FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG trades on GOLD win at 69% with a positive PnL, while AMZN (29% win) and HYPE (33% win) generate steep losses that drag the signal’s average PnL to -0.53%. The overall 30-trade set is unprofitable despite the strong GOLD subset.
failureClusters.recommendation: Restrict FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG to GOLD only in live trading until further shadow evidence proves robustness on other assets, or create a dedicated gold funding long variant with refined entry conditions. Continue to disable AMZN and HYPE from this signal.

newHypotheses.description: ONE_TOUCH_NO with momentum guard: only sell-YES NO contracts when the sell-YES edge exceeds 1.5 pts AND spot is below its 24h simple moving average AND 24h price change is less than +1.5%, avoiding shorting into strong momentum uptrends that have been compressing recent NO shadows.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES with edge and momentum filter will increase win rate and reduce thesis_compressed_loss events compared to the unfiltered ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO signal.

newHypotheses.description: GOLD funding extreme long enhanced: when gold funding rate annualized is in the bottom 10th percentile of its 30-day range (deeply negative) and spot is above its 24h SMA, suggesting extreme short-covering pressure combined with an intact uptrend for a high-probability long.
newHypotheses.prediction: Gold spot will rise over the next 7 days as extreme funding stress normalises within an uptrend, outperforming the broader FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG signal.

newHypotheses.description: Cross-asset funding divergence: when gold funding is deeply negative (bottom 10th percentile) and BTC funding is extremely positive (top 10th percentile) simultaneously, the divergence indicates a relative-value dislocation where gold is oversold and BTC is overbought, favouring a long gold position over the next week.
newHypotheses.prediction: Gold spot will outperform and rise over the next 7 days as funding regimes converge.

hypothesisReviews.observation: BTC PM-IV expansion/reversion hypothesis holds a 60% win rate over 6 tests but remains in limbo with no live trades. The edge is statistically compelling enough to move to a shadow trade phase with a tight stop (e.g., 2%) to gather real-market behaviour under the btc_pm_iv_expansion_reversion family.

BTC PM IV regime-relative compression shows only 1 win in 3 tests, suggesting the current 30-day bottom-20% threshold is too permissive. Consider tightening the entry to bottom-10% PM IV percentile and requiring spot above the 3-day SMA before further shadow testing.

The SHORT/NO cap-rich upside hypothesis (pure edge selling without trend filter) lost both resolved tests, consistent with the recent ONE_TOUCH_NO thesis_compressed_losses. Recommend merging a momentum guard into this hypothesis before running additional shadow tests, as proposed in the new ONE_TOUCH_NO with momentum guard hypothesis.

journalEntry: Tonight’s review centred on the ONE_TOUCH_NO failure cluster as spot trended higher against multiple short positions, confirming that the pure edge signal needs a momentum guard. Augmented the research pipeline with a new hypothesis that adds trend filters to ONE_TOUCH_NO. Asset-level lessons showed FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG is a gold-only signal in practice; recommend restricting live to gold until further notice. FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT’s low target hit rate and slightly negative PnL motivated a target reduction from 4% to 3% to capture profits more reliably. Strong blocked setups (WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG, USER_PM_IV_TOUCH_RICH_NO) remain the highest-edge opportunities pending promotion; will flag for operator review. Minor refinement of BTC PM-IV hypotheses to tighten entry thresholds and move promising H-001 toward shadow trading.
